== Luke wording and errata-source audit ==
Compared [[Luke Skywalker (Errata)]], [[Luke Skywalker (Reflections Foil)]] and [[Luke Skywalker (Japanese Reflections III Foil)]] against their actual faces and the primary rules PDFs. Decipher's November 1998 Glossary Version 2.0, p. 89, prints the “not at a Tatooine site” / “anything he pilots” text; the English Reflections foil prints it verbatim. The Japanese foil retains the earlier Japanese activation/location and starship wording. Its translation incorrectly said “he may activate” instead of “you may activate”, and its former lore comparison falsely attributed father-provided flight training to the English lore; those editorial errors were repaired without altering native printed text.

The Errata article's regular D-E1 image and high-resolution reconstruction instead use “While Luke is not on Tatooine your total Force generation is +1.” That wording is already in the PC Advanced Rulebook 1.7.1 (July 2007), Appendix A, PDF p. 106, and is not the literal November 1998 text. The image is now labelled as a later digital reconstruction; historical Card Text and the existing Decipher-only classification/IDs remain unchanged. No card face was altered or silently substituted. A recreation of the literal 1998 text would be a separate artwork task.

The earliest replacement-text publication verified in this audit is November 1998; the Glossary PDF's 17 November creation timestamp does not prove a release day. The April 1998 Current Rulings entry only discusses Luke crossing to the Dark Side; the checked June 1997 FAQ and expansion rulesheets did not establish an earlier publication of this replacement text. The July 2007 PC document establishes an upper bound for that later phrasing, not its first publication date. Earlier-origin dates remain unestablished; a wording difference alone was not treated as proof of a new gameplay state or assigned a new ID.
